This file is a filtered, scoped view of the run's full manifest.json -- only the 24 B07 entries are included here.

This run reflects the final close-out: MatchIdentityCard's compact composition was rebuilt as a 2-row grid (score+kits row 1, full-width team names row 2) so team names render in full (wrapping onto a second line where needed) instead of being truncated -- the first compact-layout fix kept the score on one line by truncating names down to a fixed max-w-[4.5rem], which discarded exactly the information distinguishing same-club team pairs (e.g. 'Slemmestad Rod' vs 'Slemmestad Hvit'). The medium+ (600px and up) composition is now a fully separate, always-present markup block restored to the exact original pre-any-fix classes -- confirmed byte-for-byte pixel-identical to this PR's own very first capture run (before any MatchIdentityCard change existed) at 1440/900/768/600px.

Same-club-suffix verification (Slemmestad Rod vs Slemmestad Hvit, Slemmestad Rod vs Slemmestad Blaa) was captured on a temporary, uncommitted scratch branch (one fixture field edited locally, never pushed to any real branch, deleted after inspection) since no existing B01-B07 fixture pairs two same-club teams -- both full names rendered correctly, clearly distinguishable, wrapped onto two lines, no overlap with the score. Not part of this attestation's own captures (those remain B07's real, unmodified fixtures) -- disclosed here as the evidence basis for that specific check.

Visually inspected directly in this session (not only hash-verified): B07-A narrow-light (320px), B07-B gb-360-dark (360px), B07-A mobile-dark-evidence-open, B04/B01-after narrow-light/dark (the two other real B01-B06 baselines sharing this component). Full team names render in every case, score stays on one line, no overlap or clipping, desktop composition unchanged.
